ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown

on Map No. 6-G in an area bound by:

The public alley next north of and parallel to West 31* Street; a line 62 feet west of and parallel to South

Halsted Street; West 31% Street; and a line 158 feet west of and parallel to South Halsted Street.

To those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 810 W 31* St, Chicago, IL 60608
